a: An open rename field that closes because of a hold, a lock or a removal leaves `renaming` set, so it reopens later and takes focus
A locked layer's children can be moved out of it, though moves into it and among its children are refused
A layer whose `children` is empty is drawn as a leaf, so an emptied group can never be dropped into again
The empty remove slot's width ignores `--wzl-button-h`, which the remove button's own width reads
b: A locked layer refuses drops into it but lets its children be dragged out, renamed and removed
A rename left open when the list is held reopens by itself and steals focus when the hold lifts
Opening and leaving the rename field renames a layer whose label has surrounding whitespace
The uncontrolled fold map keeps every toggled id forever
`moveLayers` silently drops the moved layers when the target parent is missing or is being moved
